verdict.rationale: LanceDB is a multimodal lakehouse and vector database, not an agent or assistant. Acting as an MCP client that plugs in MCP servers to use their tools is outside this product type's role. The evidence about an agent plugin (lancedb-docs-14) describes coding agents using LanceDB, not LanceDB consuming MCP tools, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
